programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Fire
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the small town residents of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign Here
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later, and witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 101

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 102

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 103

programme.title: JAG: Defending His Honor
programme.desc: An ambulance pulls up to a crash site where a woman, Jennifer Wilson, is found injured and crying for her baby. Unbeknownst to her, the six-month-old baby died in the accident. A Navy judge stands accused of vehicular homicide.

programme.title: JAG: In Country
programme.desc: Central Command coordinates an airstrike on a confirmed target traveling through Afghanistan. After the strike is launched, marine troops assess the damage and they are disturbed to learn that they targeted the wrong vehicle and hit civilians instead.

programme.title: JAG: Enemy Below
programme.desc: Kabir is preparing an attack against the U.S. and was last seen crossing the border from Afghanistan to Iran. He is believed to have recruited Capt. Yerastov, a Russian submarine captain. Turner, Harm and Mac help in the hunt for the terrorists.

programme.title: JAG: Critical Condition
programme.desc: Bud has lost his right lower leg due to a mine in Afghanistan; during emergency surgery he faces bad trouble. Sturgis returns to Washington, and Harm and Mac disobey an order from the admiral. Bud encounters an astounding change of course.

programme.title: JAG: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff dies while chasing a car carrying two SEALs in a Navy exercise. The driver stands trial for negligent homicide.

programme.title: JAG: In Thin Air
programme.desc: Lt. Albrecht and Lt. Cmdr. Zuzello make Zuzello’s farewell flight before he retires. All is fine until Albrecht notices that his partner is passed out from hypoxia. Albrecht makes an emergency landing on the ship.Harm is sent to the ship to investigate.

programme.title: JAG: Need to Know
programme.desc: As a favor from Congresswoman Lillian Dorning, SECNAV Sheffield asks the JAG staff to get the story of a submarine, USS Angel Shark (SSGN-559), which was lost on a CIA mission in 1968.

programme.title: JAG: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Harm serves as a judge and Mac is the contentious prosecutor in a case fraught withpolitical implications when an American aviator is charged with killing three Britishsoldiers during a flight mission in Afghanistan.

programme.title: JAG: Shifting Sands
programme.desc: When a Gulf War MIA victim is found as the sheik’s wife in a nomadic Arab tribe, Bud prosecutes and Mac defends her against charges of desertion and, in a stunning turn of events, treason. Harm tries to get his old job back but is turned away.

programme.title: JAG: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Mac defends and Turner prosecutes in the case of a special op marine who, during an Iraqi mission, may have deserted his team for his own survival. Harm takes on a CIA training assignment in a mach six craft that soon has him in danger.

programme.title: JAG: Close Quarters
programme.desc: Back at JAG, Harm is flooded with cases but still wants to help out an 80-year-old veteran accused of robbery. Meanwhile, Turner takes on an assignment in a sub whose crew has rescued possible defecting North Koreans.

programme.title: JAG: Posse Comitatus
programme.desc: Harm and Mac argue the case of a Marine pilot who used force to interfere with a local police matter that led to a man’s killing. Roberts is the investigating officer in the matter of a Navy doctor who is requesting conscientious objector status.

programme.title: JAG: The Boast
programme.desc: When an unwitting corporal boasts to a reporter that he killed an Iraqi prisoner of war, facts begin to emerge that could convict him despite his later claim that he was only lying toi mpress.

programme.title: JAG: Pulse Rate
programme.desc: Harm and Mac go aboard the USS Gillcrist to determine if a seaman’s fatal accident during a routine repair was the result of a co-worker’s dereliction of duty or worse.

programme.title: JAG: Good Intentions
programme.desc: Mac defends a petty officer and former alcoholic accused of a brutal murder after a drinking binge which renders him useless in remembering details that could help him. Roberts is entangled in the case of a Navy Commander accused of embezzling funds.

programme.title: JAG: People vs SECNAV
programme.desc: After an incident in Iraq claims the lives of innocent civilians, SecNav is brought up on charges of war crimes in International Court, and Harm and Mac must defend him. Meanwhile, during a trip to the arcade, little A.J. goes missing.

programme.title: JAG: Hard Time
programme.desc: Mac must accompany a prisoner who once assaulted her across the country while Harm and Bud delve into the case of an HIV-infected fleet officer who, after having his condition revealed and relegated to inactive duty, wants his old job back.

programme.title: JAG: Coming Home
programme.desc: A marine’s killing in Iraq has ramifications for JAG stateside as Harm helps the soldier’s family with a media onslaught, and Bud and Mac investigate the failure of his flack vest.

programme.title: JAG: Fighting Words
programme.desc: A general’s comments about Islam during a church service pit Harm and Mac against each other as a court-martial hearing examines whether those remarks were a danger to national security.

programme.title: JAG: Fighting Words
programme.desc: A general’s comments about Islam during a church service pit Harm and Mac against each other as a court-martial hearing examines whether those remarks were a danger to national security.

programme.desc: At the request of Seaman Saul Wainright (guest star William Sadler), who is serving a life sentence in a federal prison for stabbing a transsexual prostitute 20 years ago, Harm convinces Naval authorities to re-open the case.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers: BMW Isetta

programme.desc: Jennie Walldén lagar en riktigt härlig gryta med fläskfilé och champinjoner i en krämig sås med smak av dragon, dijonsenap och parmesan.

programme.desc: Frank är orolig för sin hälsa. Han är öm i gumpen och har svårt för att sitta stilla längre tider åt gången. En bekymrad Mia tycker att rumpan måste kollas.

programme.title: Klovn: Biggie Blackie
programme.desc: Casper och Frank har investerat i galopphästen Biggie-Blackie. De klantar sig dock med jockeyns storlek, parkeringsvakter och svarta bankrådgivare.

programme.title: Klovn: Länge Leve Demokratin
programme.desc: Snart hålls val till Folketinget och Frank hjälper lojalt sin svärfar i dennes valkampanj för Centrum-Demokraterne vilket gör att Frank kommer på kant med Enhedslisten.

programme.title: Klovn: Bögarnas Kennedy
programme.desc: Klaus Bondam ska hjälpa till med att göra Franks gata till gårdsgata. Polisen dras in och Franks envishet gör återigen att det hela går rakt mot en katastrof.

programme.title: Klovn: En Revisor-smurf-cd
programme.desc: Frank och Mia är ute efter samma sommarhus som Carøe och Susan vilket sätter parens vänskap på prov. Frank och Casper shoppar erotiska leksaker i Butik Paradis.

programme.title: Klovn: God Jul, Frank
programme.desc: Frank ska banka Mias dagskassa, men det går snett och han förlorar mobiltelefonen. Först skickar han en kärleksförklaring till Mia - men till fel telefonnummer.

programme.title: Klovn: Unga Hjärtan
programme.desc: Frank briljerar med sina kunskaper om tolvfingertarmen, Casper säger ja till att vara DJ på en stödgala för Amnesty International och Mia vill ha nya perenner.

programme.title: Klovn: Hem Till Far
programme.desc: Frank och Casper är på besök i Franks barndomshem. Det är härligt på landet och de köper motorcykeln med sidovagn som Mia alltid har önskat sig.

programme.title: Klovn: Sankt Hans
programme.desc: Frank ska fira Sankte Hans hos sina svärföräldrar, som länge har misstänkt Frank för att vara orsaken till Mias barnlöshet.

programme.title: Klovn: Bornholm
programme.desc: Casper, Frank, Mia och Iben är på Bornholm och ska köpa ett hus, men måste först godkännas av ägaren. Frank tycker att tjejerna ska flörta med ägaren.

programme.title: Klovn: Apan Ditmark
programme.desc: Frank och Casper har beslutat att sponsra apan Ditmark på Köpenhamns zoo. Casper tvingar till sig fler privilegier än sponsorer normalt har.

programme.title: Klovn: Jarlens Död
programme.desc: Frank och Casper är ute och bowlar med Jarl Friis Mikkelsen, det går som det går och senare möts de tre igen på en sorglig tillställning där Michael Meyerheim håller tal.

programme.title: Klovn: Piverts Svensexa
programme.desc: Pivert och Bodil ska gifta sig. Frank och Casper är bjudna. Casper tycker att han har gjort tillräckligt med välgörenhetsarbete och tackar därför nej till inbjudan.

programme.title: Klovn: Hejsan, Sverige!
programme.desc: Frank och Casper har bjudit in Lars Hjortshøj i sitt företag. De ska på teambuildingresa till Sverige där det bjuds på vackra flickor, fisk i sjön och lägereld.

programme.title: Klovn: Tango För Tre
programme.desc: Frank och Casper går på kändiskarate med Jimmy Jørgensen, Alexander Kølpin och Jan Gintberg. Peter Gantzler tränar gruppen och kräver militär disciplin.

programme.title: Klovn: Oops!
programme.desc: Casper väljs till att spela Kapten Haddock i en amerikansk storfilm. Kyssar i en cykeltaxi och övernattning i ett främmande hem riskerar Mias och Franks förhållande.

programme.title: Klovn: Mamma Mia
programme.desc: Frank och Mia vill adoptera ett barn men måste bli godkända av adoptionsbyrån. Frank tänker ställa upp och vara jultomte i fäktningsklubben och Mia gör vad hon kan för att han ska framstå i bra dager.

programme.title: Klovn: Mera Ost Christian Braad Thomsen?
programme.desc: Casper och Frank tycker att staten gör för lite för äldre människor och konstnärer och startar en think tank ihop med några gamla bekanta; Ib Michael, Suzanne Brøgger och Leif Sylvester. Frank och Mia vill utveckla sitt sexliv.

programme.title: Klovn: White House Potential
programme.desc: Mia får privatlektioner i sjukgymnastikmetoden Mensendieck av 60-årige Jønne och lovar att mata hans fiskar när han är bortrest. Casper menar att han har "white house potential" eftersom 95 procent av allt han säger stämmer.

programme.title: Klovn: Tack För Svanäggen
programme.desc: Frank och Casper arbetar på ett manus som Bille August är intresserad av. De vill åka till Malaga och skriva, som på den gamla goda tiden. Mia går en krokikurs men tycker inte att Frank stöttar hennes kreativa ambitioner.

programme.title: Klovn: Den Japanska Trädgården
programme.desc: Casper och Iben ska gifta sig i Thailand, på åtta meters djup, så vännerna håller på att ta dykarcertifikat. Frank är stolt över rollen som best man men det trasslar till sig när han ska hjälpa Casper att klara upp sitt förflutna med Signe Lindkvist.

programme.title: Klovn: Trollkarlen Från Frederiksberg
programme.desc: Casper har blivit inbjuden till en prestigefylld orden men det finns ingen plats för Frank, till hans stora besvikelse. Men eftersom han skrivit en Sagan om ringen-analogi om politik blir han i alla fall inbjuden till en grupp lajvare.

programme.title: Klovn: Hör På Nu, Frank
programme.desc: Frank och Mia ska åka till Kina men han oroar sig över att Muffi ska vara med Morten Olsens hund. Casper och Frank har börjat fäktas och här går snacket om impotens och Viagra.

programme.title: Klovn
programme.desc: Frank fyller 40 och det ska firas på Hotel Josty. Casper har varit hans bästa vän i 11 år och ska vara toastmaster. Men det blir konstig stämning när han i sitt tal erbjuder sperma så att Mia och Frank kan få barn.

programme.title: Klovn: Muffen Fäller
programme.desc: Det lackar mot jul och Mia och Frank ger varandra adventskalender-presenter. Frank får ett par skridskor och orsakar tumult på skridskobanan. Det blir också ett och annat obekvämt besök på kemtvätten.

programme.title: Klovn: Surprise Mia
programme.desc: Iben och Casper ska på brittiska filmgalan BAFTA och hon har med alla sina Louis Vuitton-väskor. Mia tvivlar på Franks kärlek och tänker att han hellre vill vara ihop med någon kändis, så han planerar en överraskning för henne.

programme.title: Klovn: Gotteligott
programme.desc: Casper är deppig och ligger mest i sin säng. Frank köper en videokamera för att muntra upp honom men Casper tycker inte att det händer något värt att filma. Samtidigt blir det stort drama i Mias butik och kameran är nyckeln till allt.

programme.title: Klovn: Shut Up
programme.desc: När Mias butik blir rättvisemärkt träffar Frank en fängslande kvinna. Men raggningsförsöket slutar i att han och Mia får husera en tibetansk flykting. Casper är deprimerad och tycker att han inte får cred för att han hjälpt komikerkollegor.

programme.title: Klovn: De Flätade Skorna Och Ägget
programme.desc: Mia vill skaffa en ny stol men Frank tycker inte att de ska lägga pengar på dyra möbler. Han vill hellre investera i en gräsklippare som ska delas med grannen. När Frank träffar en norsk tjej råkar han utge sig för att vara Muhammed-tecknare.

programme.title: Klovn: Fru Då-och-då
programme.desc: Mia och Frank har flyttat in hos hennes föräldrar men har svårt att hitta tid och plats för varandra. Caspers depression har blivit så allvarlig att han lagts in på sjukhus. Frank måste nu välja mellan att prioritera sex eller sin väns välbefinnande.

programme.title: Klovn: Monsieur Le Boss
programme.desc: Mia bjuder med Frank på en avslappnande spa-weekend på hotell, men det blir trassel med såväl kama sutra som tarmsköljning. Casper rymmer från sjukhuset och Frank måste leta upp honom.

programme.title: Klovn: Bedragsholms Slott
programme.desc: Frank, Mia, Casper och Iben åker på en weekend-tripp till Dragsholms slott, tillsammans med Lars Hjorthøj och hans fru Tina. Kvinnorna ser fram emot en lugn och skön helg, medan grabbarna vill hänga runt och jaga, men allt spårar ur snabbt.

programme.title: Klovn: Bispebjerg-tricket
programme.desc: Frank och Mia tittar på ett hus där den förre ägarens fru är död, men kroppen aldrig hittades. Niels berättar hemligheten bakom Bispebjerg-tricket för Casper och Frank - det närmaste man kan komma sex med någon annan utan att vara otrogen.

programme.desc: Frank väntar otåligt på att vännen och kollegan Casper ska bli bättre och under tiden hjälper han Mia lite halvt i te-butiken. Plötsligt vaknar Casper till och har en ny idé. Mias 12-årige brorson är på besök och Frank tycker att de är konstiga.

programme.desc: Efter månader av sexmessande med en snygg modell vill Marvin träffa honom öga mot öga.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Double Life: Nåt skändligt är i faggorna!
programme.desc: Quinton mötte halvbrodern Teran som vuxen och de fick nära kontakt. Men Teran har börjat uppträda underligt.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: You Gave Up the Cookies!
programme.desc: I tre år har Mariah bott med sin pojkvän, pappan till hennes son. Bobby visar ständigt sin kärlek.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Any Old D Will Do
programme.desc: 20-årige Andrew har jobbat dygnet runt för att kunna bilda familj med sin tjej Nikki.

programme.title: Just Tattoo Of Us: My Mam And Dad!
programme.desc: Charlottes pojkvän Josh är hennes bisittare, och hennes föräldrar ska pröva sitt äktenskap.

programme.title: Just Tattoo Of Us: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Tatueraren Charl hjälper Charlotte i programmet. Saffron och Sheniya ger varandra ett budskap, Mary och hennes son Lewis testar familjebanden.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: No Doubt
programme.desc: Framförandena omfattar: "Don't Speak", "Ex Girlfriend", "Just a Girl", "Simple Kind of Life", "Sunday Morning" och "Trapped in a Box".

programme.title: MTV Unplugged: Stone Temple Pilots Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged visar inspelade liveframträdanden av populära musikartister som spelar akustiska eller "unplugged" variationer av låtar.

programme.title: Ink Master: Kampen mellan städerna
programme.desc: 15 tatuerare från hela världen kämpar för att representera sina hemstäder.

programme.title: Revenge Prank with DJ Pauly D & Vinny: The Prank with the Porcupine
programme.desc: Pauly D hjälper Samiah att hämnas på sin mamma Chivon. Samiah bjuder in mamma för att träffa nye 'pojkvännen' och hans familj.

programme.title: Revenge Prank with DJ Pauly D & Vinny: The Prank that Works Out
programme.desc: Vinny hjälper Andrea att hämnas på sin make, Seth.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: Foo Fighters
programme.desc: Foo Fighters rockar loss till några av de största hitsen och berättar om låtarnas bakgrund. De framför singeln "Wheels" och gamla hits som "Everlong".

programme.desc: Scifitrillerissä kansainvälisen avarauusaseman tiedemiehet löytävät elämänmuodon, joka uhkaa paitsi heidän myös koko maapallon elämää.

programme.title: Beck: Tuhkattu
programme.desc: Beck-ryhmä saa tutkittavakseen tapauksen, jossa pastori on kuollut Helluntaikirkon mailla tapahtuneessa tuhopoltossa. Rikospaikalle saapuvalle Alexille tapauksesta tulee henkilökohtainen, kun hän tapaa henkilön menneisyydestään. Avuksi rikostutkintaan Alex värvää mentorinsa Martin Beckin.

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Chris Hemsworth. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: Veijarikopla ja musta timantti
programme.desc: Veijarikopla tekee paluun valkokankaalle. Tällä kertaa Vanhedenin ja Dynamiitti-Harryn on pärjättävä ilman Sickania. Onneksi Wall-Enbergillä on idea.

programme.title: Triangle of Sadness
programme.desc: Triangle of Sadness -elokuvassa mallipariskunta Carl ja Yaya lähtevät luksusristeilylle yhdessä miljonäärien, ystävällismielisten asekauppiaiden ja marxilaisen merikapteenin kanssa. Matkalla tapahtuva katastrofi saa ihmisten väliset hierarkiat äkkiä kääntymään päälaelleen jokaisen kamppaillessa omasta selviytymisestään. Ruben Östlundin (Turisti, The Square) kohuttu ja tarkkanäköinen draamakomedia.

programme.title: Second Act
programme.desc: Komedia Mayasta (Jennifer Lopez), joka kyllästyy siihen, ettei saa ylennystä supermarketissa, ja hankkii itselleen pomon paikan tekaistun CV:n avulla.

programme.title: Hustlers - Korkojen kera
programme.desc: Kiitetty rikosdraama strippareista Ramona (Jennifer Lopez) ja Destiny (Constance Wu), joiden on vaikeaa pitää elämänsä kasassa. Yhdessä muutamien kollegojensa kanssa he päättävät alkaa huijaamaan rahaa hämäräperäisiltä Wall Street -asiakkailtaan.

programme.title: Viimeinen tanssi
programme.desc: Colin Nutleyn draamatrilleri sijoittuu Blackpoolissa järjestettävään tanssikilpailuun, johon osallistuu ruotsalaispareja. Yksi osallistuja murhataan.

programme.title: Tiistaiklubi
programme.desc: Draamakomedia Karinista, jonka perhe-elämä kääntyy ylösalaisin. Ruoanlaittokurssilla hän huomaa, ettei koskaan ole liian myöhäistä seurata unelmiaan.

programme.title: Iso paksu isäni
programme.desc: Rolf Lassgårdin Guldbagge-palkittu draama sijoittuu kesään 1959. Ruotsin pölyisillä teillä liikkuu Volvo PV kyydissään 11-vuotias Osvald ja tämän vanhemmat. Isällä on tapansa mukaan suuria suunnitelmia; hän aikoo opettaa kirkkokuorolle uuden messun, pelata jalkapalloa poikansa kanssa ja parantaa kuntoaan juoksemalla traktorin perässä.

programme.title: What's love got to do with it?
programme.desc: Miten nykymaailmassa oikein löytää rakkauden? Tässä romanttisessa komediassa tapaamme Lontoossa lapsuudenystävät Zoen ja Kazin, joiden tapa lähestyä ihmissuhteita on erilainen.

programme.title: Bert pilaa kaiken
programme.desc: Parhaat ystävät Bert ja Åke aloittavat TET-viikot. Samalla tapahtuu jotain mullistavaa: Åke rakastuu ensimmäistä kertaa elämässään Mollyyn, joka on TET-harjoittelussa yhdessä Bertin kanssa. Mutta myös Bert on ihastunut samaan tyttöön ja Mollykin tuntuu pitävän hänestä! Pian ongelmat kasaantuvat melkoiseksi sekasotkuksi ja Bert on vaarassa menettää sekä parhaan ystävänsä että suuren rakkautensa.

programme.title: Myrskyn ratsastajat
programme.desc: Moderni toimintaklassikko, jossa Keanu Reevesin esittämä FBI-agentti soluttautuu surffarijengiin, jota epäillään pankkiryöstäjiksi.

programme.title: Scream 5
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sen jälkeen, kun Woodsboron kaupunkia järkytti sarja raakoja murhia, se tapahtuu taas. Menneisyyden salaisuudet paljastuvat, kun tekijä riehuu viidennen kerran. Nyt vain pari eloonjäänyttä voi pysäyttää murhaajan Ghostface-maskin takana.

programme.title: Scream 5
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sen jälkeen, kun Woodsboron kaupunkia järkytti sarja raakoja murhia, se tapahtuu taas. Menneisyyden salaisuudet paljastuvat, kun tekijä riehuu viidennen kerran. Nyt vain pari eloonjäänyttä voi pysäyttää murhaajan Ghostface-maskin takana.

programme.title: Together
programme.desc: Vuosia yhdessä olleet Tim ja Millie ovat elämänsä käännekohdassa. Kun he muuttavat suurkaupungista maalle uuden alun toivossa, heillä on vain toisensa. Mutta pinnan alla kytevät jännitteet, ja pian he kohtaavat karmivan yliluonnollisen voiman, joka uhkaa tuhota heidän elämänsä, rakkautensa – ja koko olemassaolonsa. Australialaisen body horror -kauhuelokuvan tähtinä ovat Dave Franco ja Alison Brie.

programme.title: Beck: Varjoissa
programme.desc: Tukholman lähiössä tapahtuu kuolettava ampuminen, ja veriteosta epäillään väkivaltaista jengiä. Epäillyt löytyvät pian sidottuina rikospaikan läheltä, ja kaiken taustalla vaikuttaa olevan mystinen hahmo, jolla on hämäriä motiiveja. Beckin tiimi lähtee rajat ylittävään operaatioon löytääkseen jengin johtajan ja selvittääkseen, kuka tuo tuntematon toimija on. Beck: Varjoissa on sarjan 54. elokuva.

programme.title: Kertausharjoitukset
programme.desc: Vanhojen kaverusten kertausharjoitukset menevät aivan läskiksi, kun osanottajat ovat kiinnostuneempia naisten jahtaamisesta, hotellilla tanssimisesta sekä ruoasta ja juomasta. Janne "Loffe" Carlsson on huippukunnossa klassikkokomediassa.

programme.title: Hammarskjöld
programme.desc: Vuonna 1961 kylmän sodan aikaan Dag Hammarskjöldillä on vielä vuosi jäljellä tehtävässään YK:n pääsihteerinä. Tämän jälkeen hän aikoo muuttaa taloonsa Österleniin ja nauttia odottamastaan vapaudesta. Kylmä sota kuitenkin jatkuu, yhtenä keskipisteenään Kongon kriisi. Hammarskjöld ottaa tehtäväkseen rauhan välittämisen maahan, tehtävän jota moni pitää mahdottomana.

programme.title: The Last Letter from Your Lover
programme.desc: Romanttinen draama Jojo Moyesin bestsellerin pohjalta kahdesta eri aikakausien naisesta, jotka jäävät arvoituksellisten rakkauskirjeiden pauloihin.

programme.title: Under solen
programme.desc: On vuosi 1956. Pienellä ruotsalaistilalla asuu maanviljelijä Olof. Eräänä päivänä hän laittaa lehteen ilmoituksen: "Yksinäinen maanviljelijä, 39, etsii nuorta naista taloudenhoitajaksi. Toiveena valokuva." Pian kaupungista saapuu Ellen.

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterna Hallie och Donnalee driver ett stort byggprojekt för en excentrisk miljardär, Adam Barr. Hallie, som har letat efter sin drömman, hittar honom plötsligt i grannhuset. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiven Max Warner är övertygad om att Sandra Applewhites död inte var en olyckshändelse utan att hennes make John Gilman mördade henne. När han möter Sandras tvillingsyster Nicky ber han henne om hjälp. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny Montana ger aldrig sin sjaskiga biträdande jurist Claire Bernard en andra blick. Men när han börjar se en oslipad diamant i Claire, börjar han förvandla henne till en förtjusande skönhet. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah och Amy, bästa vänner sedan universitetet, anordnar sin första konstutställning i en liten stad i New England. När gåtfulla främlingar kommer in i deras liv och romantik uppstår utvecklas det utmaningar. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: När Robert får veta om sin brors båtolycka ger han sig ut för att hämta kroppen och möter Evie Shaw, ägare till marinan där hans bror hyrde båten. Han blir besatt av sin brors misstänkta död ... och av Evie. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirman Carly Westin går med på att förbereda en festmåltid för en vän som vill imponera på en man. Men paret blir dödat när hon är i köket. När polisutredaren Jack blir inblandad måste han skydda Carly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: När den oroliga Dominique ber sin bokälskande syster Kimberly att anta rollen som en glamorös parisisk modell i en månad, tvekar Kimberly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: När Lisa vaknar upp på sjukhuset minns hon ingenting: vem hon är, hennes man Pauls avsikt att skilja sig från henne eller att hon blev svårt misshandlad och lämnad att dö i en gränd. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne Marie Kerr misstänker att hennes bror Alans död inte är en olycka och bestämmer sig för att utreda saken. Hon börjar arbeta för den mäktiga familjen som kan vara inblandad i Alans död. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En föräldralös (Mel Harris) strävan att spåra sitt förflutna börjar med ett barndomsfoto av henne själv bredvid en sällsynt speldosa och leder henne till en förförisk skattjägare. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers verden rakner når to lekre menn plutselig dukker opp: en sexy, ny klassekamerat og den søte eks-stebroren hennes. Nå oppdager hun at når det kommer til kjærlighet, er hun totalt uvitende.

programme.title: Dating Amber

programme.title: Presidentkandidaten
programme.desc: En mann blir med i den politiske kampanjen til en sleip presidentkandidat i USA.

programme.title: Tully

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nesten tjue år etter at kult-serien Galaxy Quest ble kansellert, ber romvesener besetningen om hjelp til å redde universet.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en skikkelig filmfrik som eier en liten videobutikk. Når han ikke sitter som naglet fast foran fjernsynsapparatet og en eller annen film noir, diskuterer han film med de to medarbeiderne sine, supernerden Lucien og den noe mer stabile Jonathan.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: En komedie om en stuntmann som aldri har greid å lande uten å besvime og om forsøket på å mestre sitt livs største stunt.

programme.title: Asteroid
programme.desc: Sammen med sin kone og datter flytter en mand fra storbyen til sit drømmehus i udkanten af en lille by, fjern fra al kommunikation. Timingen kunne dog have været bedre, da det viser sig, at verden er ved at kollapse.

programme.title: Murder!
programme.desc: En nævning i en mordsag stemmer for at dømme, mens de andre nævninge tænker sig om og begynder at efterforske på egen hånd før henrettelsen.

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller hovedrollen som Tripper Harrison, lejrchefen på Camp North Star. Der er masser af sjov og ballade i vente, mens han sammen med lejrens øvrige ledere gør, hvad han kan for at bryde alle regler.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: Mit navn er Nobody
programme.desc: I denne klassiske western er den berygtede og legendariske revolvermand Jack Beauregard (Henry Fonda) på jagt efter sin brors mordere. Han har sat sig for, at denne morderjagt skal blive afslutningen på en lang karriere.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Ét blik og du ved, at de kommer fra et meget mærkeliget sted. De kommer fra New Jersey, via "Frankrig", via fjerntliggende, langt-ude Remulak. De er Coneheads.

programme.title: Hatari!
programme.desc: Instruktøren Howard Hawks slår sig igen sammen med John Wayne, der leder en gruppe professionelle storvildtjægere i Afrika. Men de bruger ikke kugler - de fange farligt storvildt med stærkt reb og kameraer til zoologiske haver og cirkusattraktioner.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man And His Dream
programme.desc: En bildesigner går imod hele bilindustrien med sine revolutionerende bildesigns.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Borderland / Mars: Red Dawn
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets / Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds
programme.sub-title: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets / Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.sub-title: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Gas Giants
programme.desc: In the cold, dark expanse of our solar system, beyond the asteroid belt, lie the giant planets. Some can be seen with the naked eye, others have been visited by our camera. What secrets do they hold?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire
programme.desc: The Northern Lights are more than just beautiful; they tell us about the make up of our planet, our sun, and may even be a signpost for the possibility of life on other planets.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.sub-title: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 1
programme.desc: Between 1960 and 1972, mankind boldly went where no human had been before. Across 11 manned missions, 24 men flew to the moon and 12 walked upon its surface. This film documents Apollo 17 through the eyes of the astronauts who flew.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Fler människor dödas 1944 än någonsin tidigare på Auschwitz. Nazisterna försöker skapa förvirring bland de allierade i öst, och de västallierade fattar beslut om att förhandla med nazisterna om judarna och bomba lägret.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: 1945 befriar Röda armén Auschwitz-Birkenau. När andra befrielseaktioner sker de följande månaderna, chockas världen. De överlevande judarna möter fasor när de försöker återvända till sina liv, och få SS-män hittas och ställs inför rätta.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I en kapplöpning med tiden korsade över 800 privata båtar Engelska kanalen för att rädda de förlistade soldaterna från infernot på Dunkerques stränder. Se enskilda veteraners extraordinära hjältemod i ett slag som förändrade andra världskrigets gång.

programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Flere mennesker bliver dræbt i 1944 end nogensinde før i Auschwitz. Nazisterne forsøger at skabe forvirring blandt de Allierede i Øst, og de Vestallierede træffer beslutninger om at forhandle med nazisterne om jøderne og bombardere lejren.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: I 1945 befriede Røde Hærs soldater Auschwitz-Birkenau. Da andre befrielsesoperationer finder sted i de følgende måneder, er verden chokeret.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: Relive the bravery of the Dunkirk veterans in defenseless boats crossing the English Channel to rescue the stranded soldiers through their uplifting stories of heroism in a battle that changed the course of WWII.

programme.title: Skål for sandheden

programme.desc: Läkaren Lars försöker ta sig ur sin sorg och förtvivlan efter att ha förlorat sin hustru och yngsta son i en bilolycka.

programme.title: Amorosa
programme.desc: Historien om den omdebatterade författarinnan Agnes von Krusenstjerna under perioden 1913-30.

Men personal och gäster på anläggningen säger att det händer andra märkliga saker i området. Människor känner sig iakttagna och m...

programme.title: Det okända
programme.desc: Lovisa Nilsson och hennes mamma Carina bor i Markaryd i Småland. Lugnet i deras villa störs av ljudet från någon som springer i trapporna, underliga ljusfenomen och en mansgestalt som visar sig på natten. Mediet Camilla Öhrnberg beger sig till Småland för att undersöka saken.

programme.title: Förhäxad
programme.desc: Prue får veta att ett gammalt ex håller på att lockas till att bli demon. För att rädda hans själ tar hon, Piper och Phoebe sig in i en livsfarlig brottningsring i underjorden. Där kan minsta felsteg bli deras sista.

programme.title: Förhäxad
programme.desc: Phoebe kopplas psykiskt och fysiskt till det våldsamma förflutna i en spökstad i vilda västern, komplett med hästar, cowboys och revolvrar. För att rädda sin syster måste Prue resa tillbaka i tiden och bryta länken.

programme.title: Dispatches
programme.desc: Den kinesiska shopping-appen Temu har exploderat i popularitet, med över en halv miljard användare världen över som lockats av dess rekordlåga priser. I denna dokumentär undersöker reportern Ellie Flynn om priserna är för bra för att vara sanna.

programme.title: Hela England bakar - julspecial
programme.desc: Julstämningen trängs med adrenalinet när tävlingstältet är julpyntat och deltagare från tidigare säsonger av Hela England bakar möts upp på nytt för att avgöra vem av dem som är bäst på julbak i Hela England bakar - julspecial. programme.title: Australiens mästerkock - dessertmästarna

programme.title: Hundar utan hyfs

programme.title: Fabriken inifrån

programme.title: Morden i Marlow
programme.desc: Husets ägare kommer med ett chockerande avslöjande och Tanika blir rasande då han kan ha undanhållit viktiga bevis för polisen. Teamet hoppas att kamerorna fångat mördaren, men ju fler frågor som uppstår desto mer ökar konflikterna mellan vännerna.

programme.title: Återskaparna England

programme.title: Mord i Paradiset

programme.title: Mord i Paradiset
programme.desc: Jack och hans kollegor ställs inför deras svåraste utmaning hittills.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex

Who will be left to fight for their survival and defeat this unearthly force of murderous carnage?

programme.title: The Glass House (2001)
programme.desc: Orphaned when their parents are killed in an automobile accident, Ruby (16) and Rhett (11) are placed under the guardianship of longtime friends named Gary & Erin Glass. The successful and childless couple at first welcome and console the kids but their attitudes change with the passing of time. The rebellious Ruby begins to suspect that Erin is a junkie and Gary is a drug dealer in hock to the Mob. Also, the two may have murdered the kid's parents in order to access their estate.

programme.title: The Fog

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon is a timeless story that takes place in feudal China when miracles were credible and spirits and gods were present in man's world. It is not unbelievable that zen warriors float through the air, skim the water and battle in trees and on rooftops. Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

The sheriff finds that he must destroy this murderous killer who has been made indestructible through genetic engineering.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad Of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: The story of NASCAR racing sensation Ricky Bobby, whose "win at all costs" approach has made him a national hero. He and his loyal racing partner and childhood friend, Cal Naughton, Jr., are a fearless duo that thrill their fans by finishing most races in the top spots - with Ricky Bobby always leading the pack. When a flamboyant French Formula One driver Jean Girard challenges him for the supremacy of NASCAR, Ricky Bobby must face his own demons and fight Girard for the right to be known as racing's top driver.

programme.desc: Best friends and neighbors, Ryan Woodman and Maggie Carter, are four weeks away from the prom, and they've agreed to go together if they don't have real dates. Then Chris, a cool guy from the football team, offers to help Ryan connect with Ashley, a popular blond. In exchange, a la Cyrano, Chris needs Ryan's help to get close to Maggie. Ryan makes the deal, helps the dastardly Chris play Maggie, takes advantage of Ashley's lack of self-esteem, loses his values, makes fun of his geeky friends, and falls in Maggie's estimation. Maggie is fooled by Chris, poised to be his next score. Before prom night is over, with its Titanic theme, will Ryan stop sinking?

Skip (Wilder) and Harry (Pryor) have both been fired from their jobs, so they take off in their van for California to seek fame and fortune, but somewhere along the way the van conks out and they're broke and...well, they have to eat, right? So they land a gig as singing and dancing woodpeckers to promote a bank opening. When two bank robbers steal their costumes and stick up the bank, guess who gets the blame? Skip and Harry are carted off to the state pen for 125 years. They try to keep their sanity and their lives amidst: a sadistic warden, a hulking mass-murderer and an inter-prison rodeo - all with great hilarity.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Tony's unauthorized chili is "hot" not because of the sauce, but because of his conniving cousin Arvel.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.sub-title: One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind
programme.desc: Luck for Tony and Roger -- Jeannie proves to be one-of-a-kind.

Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.sub-title: One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind
programme.desc: Luck for Tony and Roger -- Jeannie proves to be one-of-a-kind.
